causal_half_plane: response analytic in the UPPER half omega-plane; poles in the LOWER half
causality_enforcement: structural: damping is a strictly positive function of an unconstrained variable, so every pole is in the lower half omega-plane for every parameter value. Kramers-Kronig is a diagnostic only.
constitutive_relation: D = eps E - zeta B ; H = zeta^T E + [mu^-1] B   (E,B representation)
dissipated_power: = (omega/2) Im[ E* . D + H* . B ] = (omega/2) v^dagger L v, L = (C - C^dagger)/(2i)
hard_feasibility: bounded parameter transforms plus projection. A soft-penalty result is never labelled feasible.
model_family: Lorentz + optional Drude, isotropic; mu parameterized directly, mu^-1 derived; zeta = z(w) K, reciprocal
passive_sign: Im eps >= 0 for omega > 0; more generally L positive semidefinite
scope: A passing result is a passive, causal parametric constitutive model that approximates the target response over a stated frequency band. It is NOT a fabricated medium or an experimental device. No unit-cell geometry, no hardware control model, no Maxwell propagation.
